svg.title: Sign-in with OIDC and a backend for frontend
svg.desc: Sequence diagram with 5 participants: Browser (actor), Web / BFF, Keycloak, Domain API and Postgres (database). 15 messages, in order: 1. Browser to Web / BFF: GET /grades. 2. Web / BFF to Browser: Redirect, PKCE (reply). 3. Browser to Keycloak: Sign in, 2FA. 4. Keycloak to Browser: Code (reply). 5. Browser to Web / BFF: Callback with code. 6. Web / BFF to Keycloak: Exchange code. 7. Keycloak to Web / BFF: Tokens (reply). 8. Web / BFF to itself: Create session. 9. Web / BFF to Domain API: Load grades. 10. Domain API to Postgres: Set tenant, SELECT. 11. Postgres to Domain API: own school only (reply). 12. Domain API to Web / BFF: Grades (reply). 13. Web / BFF to Browser: Page, session cookie (reply). 14. Keycloak to Web / BFF: Backchannel logout (asynchronous). 15. Web / BFF to itself: End sessions. Fragment opt "central sign-out" spans messages 14–15.
